protocol.chrome: fresh headless Chrome for each trial
protocol.cpu: CDP process-family CPU time divided by steady wall time, one-core percent
protocol.rss: peak summed Chrome process RSS; shared pages may double count
protocol.mainThread: renderer CDP TaskDuration and ScriptDuration deltas
protocol.startup: open through play and >0.5 second media progression
protocol.seek: API seek completion to 10 and 1 seconds
protocol.eof: playback ended event after seek to 35 seconds
protocol.limitations: Single shared macOS host; no competitor campaign; browser GPU and OS media-service CPU outside CDP family. Trials are local synthetic stereo fixtures.
